title: One-Time 2024/2025/2026 Sealed Validation and Confirmation
mission: Execute the predeclared one-time temporal confirmation sequence without turning holdouts into tuning data.
steps: Audit whether 2024/2025/2026 outcomes have previously influenced choices.
Open 2024 exactly once and score frozen candidate/baselines.
If passed, refit using unchanged architecture/hyperparameters through 2024 and open 2025 once.
If passed, optionally replay 2026 YTD as a second untouched holdout; never call it prospective unless live predictions existed.
Do not tune from failed slices; return findings to a new development cycle with remaining holdout policy revised.
failure: Contaminated holdout: label exploratory and do not claim confirmation
